race.description: Australian National Field Days 22nd -24th Oct Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: FANTASY CROWNED (11) bumped into the classy Puffin two back, then savaged the line with a tidy fourth over 1200m at Forbes. Near his top third up and gets in light with Stiff's 1.5kg claim. Ready to score a long overdue victory. SWEET TREATS (9) resumes in a winnable race with the blinkers coming off. Raced in much stronger company last prep and has been fitted with the one 900m trial. Top three contender. VINARI (4) returned to form over her preferred trip with a tough on-pace second over 1400m at Cootamundra with the 59.5kg. Best figures measure up and expected to go close. I AM MAMWAAZEL (3) returned to the winners' circle after a long while in the wilderness last time out over 1200m at Wagga, scoring by a head. Include.
